rawContent: It's very telling the famous men who are speaking out against the #MeToo movement. Lest we forget -> https://t.co/FmIVcDetde

Many women recall the injustice of what happened to #AnitaHill 25 yrs later. NOT AGAIN.  No more of men controlling our bodies, preying upon women, silencing our voices and suffering little to no consequences.

Not for another generation of women. #metoo
